description: Like a post. Requires post_id, obtainable from search_posts, get_post_detail or find_nearby results. Liking twice is not an error. If the bubble has already expired, a like extends it by 24 hours.

post_id.description: Post id. The 8-character short id is enough; a full id or a post link also works
